atlas.title: Measurement of the Z boson invisible width at 13 TeV with the ATLAS detector
atlas.locator: Measurement strategy and extraction of the invisible width from the constant fit to recoil-bin ratios; lepton universality and external LEP leptonic width.

atlas_table.locator: HEPData Table 1, Width = invisible, Width [MeV], error labels stat and sys; sqrt(s) = 13000 GEV.

lep_original.interpretation: R_inv and the charged leptonic width are inferred from lineshape data under lepton universality. r_nu is an external SM massless single-neutrino to charged-lepton width ratio. n_eff is an effective width ratio, not a directly counted number. Published rounded inputs yield 2.9846 rather than the reported 2.9840 (discussed by Janot and Jadach).

lep_updated.interpretation: Reanalysis of the same published LEP lineshapes with updated luminosities and SM r_nu. Fit inputs are the lepton-universal submatrix, not detector counts. The tau correction is fixed in this rounded-input replay.

atlas.interpretation: Independent ATLAS event sample; fit to corrected invisible-to-dilepton recoil ratios using jet plus missing transverse momentum or dileptons. The MeV result uses an external LEP charged-leptonic width assuming universality; not an independent absolute scale.

boundary.interpretation: No joint likelihood, combined significance, raw count, IDT prediction or inferred family ontology. SM per-species normalization and the LEP charged-lepton MeV anchor, if used, remain external.
